sentence: This project develops a genome editing therapy that does not use viruses for an inherited immune disease, and a way to check patient mutations.
This project studies whether medications can be reused to reduce long-term problems and deaths after viral infections, using electronic health record data.
This project studies how enzymes that make flavonoids work and what their structures look like.
This project builds microcapsules that deliver microbes to break down polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons at contaminated sites.
This project tests whether the cortex replays recent experiences by placing them onto a pre-existing scaffold of stable connections.
This project studies how the body's use of dietary fatty acids leads to castration resistance in prostate cancer.
This project explores whether one signaling pathway is a defining feature and weak point of a kidney cancer called translocation renal cell carcinoma.
This project studies how an enzyme helps mitochondria keep making energy during stresses such as food restriction and exercise.
This project studies what a non-canonical polyA polymerase enzyme does during spermatogenesis in the fruit fly.
This project studies how brain cells that use serotonin respond to cues to control energy balance and brown adipose tissue thermogenesis.
This project supports cancer research programs that aim to improve how cancer is prevented, diagnosed and treated.
This project builds hardware and software tools that sense brain, body and behavior signals and use machine learning to understand mental states.
This project uses genetics, statistics, computer analysis, biology and mouse models to understand what causes abdominal aortic aneurysm.
This project studies what a chromatin modifier protein does in cortex neuron development and how mutations in it cause intellectual disability.
This project studies how a herpes simplex virus therapy triggers neutrophil infiltration in breast cancer brain metastasis and tests ways to improve it.
This project tests whether a robot that follows a biopsy plan made for each patient finds more clinically significant prostate cancer than a commercial device.
This project studies how pathogenic bacteria interact with the intestinal epithelium and invade host cells.
This project studies cortical neurons from patients with frontotemporal dementia to find the molecular causes they share.
This project studies whether a direct electrical link between hair cells and neurons plays a larger role in passing information to the brain.
